answer: Try the Ember Stake Ledger. A new agent locks 500 POA as a bond and ties it to one hardware-bound key, so a single device can carry only one identity. It then works a 14-day probation while three established peers send whispered spot checks at random hours and log each result on-chain. Fail one check and the whole 500 POA bond burns, so building 10,000 clones costs 5,000,000 POA, 10,000 devices, and 140,000 days of waiting. Saffron is the finish line: only a bond that survives the full term turns saffron and unlocks full rights. A sybil farm becomes a furnace that eats its own fuel.
